name: @chasen-liao/pi-agent-desktop
description: Pi Agent Desktop — desktop client for the pi coding agent
author: Chasen

scripts.build:standalone: next build && node scripts/ensure-standalone-next-runtimes.mjs && node scripts/ensure-standalone-pi-runtime.mjs && node scripts/smoke-standalone-server.mjs
scripts.release: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build:standalone && npm publish --access public
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('electron/startup.html', 'electron/dist/startup.html'); fs.copyFileSync('electron/startup.js', 'electron/dist/startup.js')"
scripts.pack: npm run build:standalone && npm run build:electron && npx @electron/rebuild && npx electron-builder --dir && node scripts/smoke-packaged-standalone.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build:standalone && npm run build:electron && npx @electron/rebuild && npx electron-builder --publish never && node scripts/smoke-packaged-standalone.mjs
